integrity: Universal proof by explicit residue-class induction, accompanied by independent finite computational checks; the latter are not substitutes for infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The identities concern the ordinary regular paperfolding sequence under zero-based indexing and unrestricted two-summand sums. They do not classify generalized paperfolding sequences or representation multiplicities. The relevant chapters of Shallit (2022) and some journal-only content were not fully inspected; independent priority verification remains outstanding.
title: Exact pairwise sumsets of the regular paperfolding sign classes
